column2: Prometheus + Grafana are running on the cluster; dashboard panels are meaningful; at least one Minecraft-specific metric is collected and visualized.
column6: Monitoring stack is deployed and functional; dashboard answers "is my service healthy?" with node metrics, pod metrics, and at least one service-specific signal; panels are well-labeled and useful.
column9: Monitoring stack works; dashboard has meaningful panels but one category (node, pod, or service) is weaker.
column12: Monitoring is partially deployed; dashboard exists but lacks meaningful panels or service-specific metrics.
column15: No monitoring stack deployed, or Grafana dashboard is empty/non-functional.

column2: At least 3 actionable alerts are defined, each with clear symptoms, justified thresholds, and linked runbook steps.
column6: 3+ alerts are defined and defensible; each has a clear symptom, a justified threshold, and a linked runbook with first-response steps; alerts fire correctly when tested.
column9: 3 alerts are defined with runbooks; one alert has weaker justification or runbook linkage.
column12: Fewer than 3 alerts, or alerts lack clear symptoms/thresholds/runbooks.
column15: No alerts defined, or alerts are not linked to any runbook.

column2: A realistic failure scenario is executed end-to-end; detection, recovery, and lessons learned are documented.
column6: Failure scenario is realistic; detection is shown via dashboard/alerts/logs; recovery is executed and verified; postmortem identifies root cause, impact, and concrete improvements.
column9: Drill is executed with clear detection and recovery; postmortem is present but light on improvements.
column12: Drill is attempted but detection or recovery is unclear; postmortem is missing or superficial.
column15: No incident drill executed, or no documentation of the drill.

column2: Logs are accessible and searchable; architecture diagram is updated; on-call quickstart is usable by another operator.
column6: `kubectl logs` is demonstrated with specific event lookup; architecture diagram shows monitoring components; on-call quickstart is clear and actionable; cost controls are documented.
column9: Log access and documentation are mostly complete; one area (diagram, quickstart, or cost controls) has minor gaps.
column12: Log access is shown but documentation is partial; multiple sections missing or vague.
column15: No log access demonstrated, or documentation is largely missing.
